summary: This bill directs the Commander of the U.S. Cyber Command to submit a report to Congress detailing recommended cybersecurity actions for the Department of Defense to counter digital scams operated by transnational organized crime networks linked to the Chinese Communist Party.

scores.thoughts: The bill directs the Commander of the United States Cyber Command to report on actions to defend against cyber threats from Chinese Communist Party-linked crime networks. This directly involves military cyber defense strategies and operations, making it central to military and defense concerns.
